May 27, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
World Asset Management Inc decreased its stake in Coca Cola Co Com (KO) by 7.51% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. World Asset Management Inc sold 28,511 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.92% with the market. The institutional investor held 351,121 shares of the beverages (production and distribution) company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.11 million, down from 379,632 at the end of the previous reported quarter. World Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Coca Cola Co Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $180.42B market cap company. The stock increased 0.19% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $42.4. About 8.81 million shares traded. The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE:KO) has risen 1.35% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.20% the S&P500.
